meta.name: route-by-query-shape
meta.description: When the agent calls memory_search with a relationship-shaped query ("who did I talk to about X"), redirect to the knowledge_graph backend where it will actually find the answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将关系型查询自动路由到知识图谱后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在关系型查询时自动使用知识图谱
copy.tagline_en: Route relationship queries to knowledge graph backend automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically use knowledge graph for relationship queries

howto.what: 当 Claude 被问到关系型问题（如“我和谁讨论过 Q4？”）时，它会自动将记忆搜索路由到知识图谱后端，从而找到基于实体关系的答案。
howto.when: 当 Claude 调用 memory_search 且查询是关系型（例如询问“谁”与“什么”的关系）时触发。

say.text: 我和谁讨论过第四季度的计划？
say.note: Claude 会从知识图谱中找出相关联系人。

say.text: 谁和我一起做过 Foo 项目？
say.note: Claude 会利用实体关系返回合作者。

howto.what_en: When Claude is asked a relationship question (e.g., "who did I talk to about Q4?"), it automatically routes the memory search to the knowledge graph backend to find answers based on entity relationships.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude calls memory_search with a relationship-shaped query (e.g., asking "who" in relation to "what").

say_en.text: Who did I talk to about Q4 plans?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve the relevant contact from the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Who worked with me on the Foo project?
say_en.note: Claude uses entity relationships to return collaborators.
